query: ok so i just finished my 2nd hackathon project (a claims-triage agent on google cloud) and want to turn it into one of those forward deployed engineer case study pages, dark, palantir-ish, same vibe as the one i made for my last project. where do we start

build me a landing page for my hackathon submission that looks like palantir foundry docs meets an engineering report. near-black, thin isometric linework, one blue accent. repo is at ~/code/tern-web, next.js
i want a scroll-driven hero where an exploded stack of layers rotates as you scroll. i have a magnific mcp connected. how do i generate the frames and wire them to a canvas
make a case study page for our devpost project. honest about what we measured and what we didn't. include a results table and the misses. dark theme, no cards, no gradients
reuse the same design system as my EIOS landing for the new hackathon repo. colors, type, the isometric stack hero, all of it
need a quantumblack-style microsite for our ml project, hairline diagrams, mono numbers, an architecture figure showing which gcp services do what
can you cut a graded set of webp frames from this seedance clip (orbit.mp4) for a scroll sequence? i want the glow gone and the blue kept
our hackathon judges will only look at the page for 2 minutes. design a forward-deployed-engineer style writeup page that proves the build is real
set up the landing page for the project with the dark isometric look from before, the config-driven one, and run the honesty checks on the copy
add a results ledger section with misses in amber to my existing dark landing page, same house style
design the login screen and the main dashboard for our compliance analysts, dense tables, keyboard shortcuts, light theme
make me a bright, friendly SaaS homepage with a big hero, three metric tiles, pricing cards and a testimonial carousel
turn these notes into a 10-slide pitch deck for the hackathon final, investor tone, with a problem slide and a cost slide
create a logo and brand guide for my startup, minimal, monochrome, with a wordmark and an icon
fix the lighthouse performance score on my next.js landing page; LCP is 4s and the hero image is huge
write the README for my hackathon repo: what it does, how to run it, architecture diagram in mermaid
generate a 3 minute demo video script and voiceover for the submission, abstract graphics intro then a screen recording
add dark mode to my existing react admin panel, it currently only has a light theme and uses tailwind
build an animated svg diagram of our microservices for the docs site, readable by non-technical people
write a blog post about what we learned building an agent in a weekend hackathon, with a section on mistakes
